name: Razor Wind
text: Range: 12. Damage: 2d4 slashing, with advantage OR include a 2nd creature adjacent to your target.

source.note: The choice of advantage OR a 2nd creature is text only.

name: Breath of Life
text: Range: 6. Restore 1d4 HP to a Dying creature. If healed for 4+: they also regain 1 action.

name: Blustery Gale
text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d4 bludgeoning (advantage vs flying/Small/Tiny). Hit or miss, Knockback 2.

name: Barrier of Wind
restriction: Castable only while Defending vs Ranged.
text: Castable only while Defending vs Ranged. Reduce the Primary Die by 3. If it misses, redirect the original attack to another space within Reach 1.

source.note: No Reach:/Range: field is printed; the effect names Reach 1.

name: Echoburst
text: Reach: 1. Damage: d44 bludgeoning (ignoring armor). Any creature in the targeted space at the beginning of your next turn takes this damage again.

source.note: The "D44." sidebar printed under this spell is the general definition of d44 dice (handled by the dice engine), not spell-specific, so it is not in text (question for rules owner).

name: Eye of the Storm
text: Reach: 3, AoE. Damage: 4d4+10 bludgeoning to enemies. Place surviving creatures anywhere within 1 space of the storm’s Reach on a failed STR save.

source.note: The STR save decides placement, not half damage, so no save is encoded.

name: Updraft
text: Reach: 12, 5×5 AoE. Damage: 20 bludgeoning minus a DEX save. On 10+ damage, they land Prone and Dazed.

source.note: No roll encoded: damage is a flat 20 reduced by each target’s DEX save result, which a roll with save {half} can’t express; the GM subtracts by hand.

name: Thousand Cuts
text: Range: 12. Damage: d44 slashing with advantage. Also damages enemies within Reach 1 of your target. D44 with advantage. Roll 3d4 and drop the lowest die. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 2, 3, and 4 deals 34 damage).

source.note: "D44 with advantage." is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text (same as Necrotic’s “D66 with advantage”). No roll encoded: “d44 with advantage” (roll 3d4, drop lowest) isn't expressible as a plain roll. Header says AOE but the Range field has no “, AoE”.

name: Boisterous Winds
text: Reach: 12. Gently move all creatures up to 6 spaces, each in a straight line in a direction of your choice. At the beginning of your subsequent turns, do so again but 2 fewer spaces.

name: Wind Whisper
text: You whisper a message into the wind and it will be secretly carried to a specified target anywhere wind could reach.

name: Helpful Gust
text: Reach: 6. Gently move a Tiny unheld item in any direction. OR: Generate an illusory scent.

name: Feather Fall
restriction: Reaction: When a creature falls, cause them to gently float to the ground.
text: Reach: 6. Reaction: When a creature falls, cause them to gently float to the ground.

source.note: The Reaction: sentence holds both trigger and effect; the whole sentence is stored as restriction.
